title: Pindam
desc: When a dominant spirit begins to challenge the life of a six-year-old girl with speech disorder and now, an occultist tries to save the family and discover the hidden motive.

title: Antony
desc: Antony, a ruthless gangster, becomes a guardian to Ann Maria, the daughter of a local thug he killed. As they work on their relationship, a forgotten enemy returns to finish them off.

title: Benki
desc: When antisocial elements in a humble village community harass a young woman, her protective brother embarks on a path of vengeance.

title: International Rowdy
desc: Love invents a lethal drug and gives it to terrorist outfits, who use it to kill Indian officials in Kuala Lumpur. When RAW officers find a love emblem tattoo on his neck, they start investigating.

title: Bhairathi Ranagal
desc: Bhairathi Ranagal ends up in jail after going against the law. However, when he is released, he strives to fight for the people of his village.

title: Acharya
desc: On behalf of an idyllic temple town, Acharya takes up the cudgels against a tyrant whose greedy sights are set on the local natural resources.
